author: Inside Edition
description: A 6-year-old got his parents permission to ride his scooter alone and go to the playground. His parents say a stranger in a car stopped to ask the boy questions, including where he lived. Two days later, the parents got a visit from a child welfare worker. They say they were told someone complained their son was on the scooter unsupervised and that it was a "regular occurrence." Inside Edition's Eva Pilgrim spoke to the mom and dad, Mallerie Shirley and Christopher Pleasants. The allegations against the parents were found to be unsubstantiated.
title: Parents Investigated For Neglect After Letting Child, 6, Go To Park

author: Inside Edition
description: Don Lemon was taken into custody early Friday morning in Los Angeles after attending a pre-Grammy party. According to one report, "He was seen being handcuffed while flanked by FBI and Homeland Security agents." Lemon followed anti-ICE protestors into a church whose pastor works with ICE. The White House claims Lemon was working with the protestors, but Lemon is fighting back. His lawyer says the journalist's work in Minneapolis was "constitutionally protected."
title: Don Lemon Charged After Arrest In Connection With Anti-ICE Protest

author: Inside Edition
description: President Donald Trump and First Lady Melania Trump walked the black carpet hand-in-hand for the premiere of Melania's documentary. Melania wore a sleek black skirt suit by Dolce & Gabbana. Pete Hegseth, Dr. Oz and rapper Nicki Minaj appeared at the premiere. Marc Beckman produced the documentary and is a senior advisor to the first lady. Inside Edition went to an early showing of the one-hour and 44-minute film at a theater in Times Square.
title: First Lady Melania Trump's Self-Titled Documentary Releases

author: Inside Edition
description: There is growing outrage over reported perks being handed to Jeffrey Epstein's former girlfriend, Ghislaine Maxwell, who is now serving 20 years for child sex trafficking. Inside Edition's Les Trent spoke to Sam Mangle, a prison consultant who has three clients at the same facility as Maxwell, the Bryan Federal Prison Camp in Texas. The alleged perks, according to the New York Times, include meals delivered to her cell, playing with service dogs, and showering alone.
title: Is Ghislaine Maxwell Getting Special Treatment In Prison?

author: Inside Edition
description: Luigi Mangione will not face the death penalty by lethal injection if he is convicted of the murder of United Healthcare CEO Brian Thompson. In a 39-page ruling, the federal judge admitted his decision "may strike the average person, and indeed many lawyers, as tortured and strange." Mangione denies the murder charge. Friday's hearing took place a day after news broke of what authorities say is a bizarre attempt to "free Luigi." Mangione's attorney says he was unaware of the alleged plot to free him.
title: Luigi Mangione Will Not Face Death Penalty If Convicted, Judge Says

author: Inside Edition
description: Across the country, police are cracking down on Super Speeders - dangerous drivers cruising more than 100 mph. Under a new law in Florida, instead of just giving you a ticket, cops can arrest you if you’re caught going over 100 mph. INSIDE EDITION joined the Florida Highway Patrol on a recent speed enforcement ride-along and we also tested a new device that can prevent serial speedsters from driving over the posted speed limit.
title: Florida Cops Cracking Down On Super Speeders Cruising Over 100MPH

author: Inside Edition
description: Welcome to Christmas Island, an Australian territory in the Indian Ocean. It's home to about 1,600 people and just one canine. Shiloh came to Christmas Island as an assistance animal, but when the person she was assisting went back to the mainland, Shiloh stayed behind. Dogs were banned from the Island in the 1970s to protect the native wildlife, but Shiloh seems to have become everyone's pet. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: 5-Year-Old Shiloh Is The Lone Dog Of Christmas Island

author: Inside Edition
description: Prosecutors say Brendan Banfield shot Joseph Ryan and stabbed his wife to death, making it appear she had been attacked by a stranger.
title: Brendan Banfield Testified That Intruder Stabbed His Wife #shorts

author: Inside Edition
description: A newborn baby needed urgent transportation from one hospital to another but the snowy icy road was nearly impassible. That's when snow plow operator Joe Estes came to the rescue. His mission was to plow 20 miles to Cincinnati Children's Hospital in a blizzard so that baby Bryson could get urgent medical help. Paramedic Eric Mailloux was inside the ambulance. Estes and Mailloux spoke with Inside Edition's Les Trent.
title: Snow Plow Escorts Ohio Baby To Hospital During Winter Storm

author: Inside Edition
description: The 36-year-old claimed he was an FBI agent and had a court order for Mangione's release, police said.
title: Man Arrested For Allegedly Trying To Free Luigi Mangione From Jail #shorts
